create_generation_config: create a GenerationConfig instance with custom temperature, top_p, and max_new_tokens for sampling-based text generation
load_generation_config: load a GenerationConfig from a pretrained model name or local directory using from_pretrained method
save_generation_config: save a GenerationConfig to a local directory as JSON using save_pretrained method
get_generation_mode: get the generation mode (greedy_search, sample, beam_search) from a GenerationConfig instance
validate_generation_config: validate a GenerationConfig instance and raise errors for invalid parameter combinations
